definition_note: Potential for adverse consequences produced by hazard exposure vulnerability and context.
Limits to knowledge about future conditions probabilities impacts or system behavior.
Potential source of harm such as flood heat fire cyberattack disease conflict or financial stress.
People assets ecosystems or systems located in places or relationships where hazards can affect them.
Propensity to be adversely affected because of sensitivity limited capacity or structural disadvantage.
Ability of a system community or institution to adjust learn reorganize and respond to change.
Ability to withstand stress without significant functional degradation.
Availability of spare capacity backup pathways or overlapping functions.
System structure that limits propagation by separating components while preserving connectivity.
Failure that propagates through interdependent systems.
Persistence of a system that remains stable but unjust maladaptive or ecologically damaging.
Structural change when adaptation within existing arrangements is insufficient.
